subject: Weekend recovery plan after the deadline
text: Hey there, once this deadline finally releases us, I have a whole weekend plan queued up. On Saturday morning, I'm dragging myself to the old market for pastry and coffee, then maybe walking by the river if the weather behaves. Afternoon is for folding laundry, answering the emails that have been pretending to be urgent, and taking a long nap on the sofa. Sunday should be quieter: a short bike loop, groceries, and a movie that is definitely too long but sounds cozy. I may also try that soup recipe someone posted last month, although I'll keep expectations modest. If you need backup before Monday morning, ping me, but I am honestly hoping the quiet is the whole point.
